settings.heading: Backlit Film Printing – LED Lightbox Graphics
settings.description: Custom printed translucent backlit film for LED lightboxes, menu displays, retail signage, fake windows and illuminated displays. Designed to look sharp and vibrant when lit from behind.

settings.question: What are backlit graphics?
settings.answer: Backlit graphics are printed on premium translucent film designed to be illuminated from behind, creating vibrant and eye-catching displays. They are perfect for LED lightboxes and indoor illuminated signage.

settings.question: What sizes can you produce?
settings.answer: We offer standard sizes from A4 up to A0, plus popular lightbox sizes like 600×1200mm. We also print fully custom sizes. Use our estimator above to get an estimate for your specific dimensions.

settings.question: How do I order?
settings.answer: Choose a standard size or enter your custom dimensions, select a finish and quantity, then use Add to basket. If your option is unavailable, request a quote. Width, height and finish are saved with your order, and we check your artwork before printing.

settings.heading: Optional Extras & Design Services
settings.description: Add finishing options or let our team handle your artwork. Just add them to your basket alongside your order.
settings.note: Add-ons are optional and added separately to your basket.

settings.heading: Need backlit graphics?
settings.description: Get an instant price using our estimator or contact us for unusual projects and high volume orders.
